title: Signal: Result of send() ignored (solidity) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on bare send() calls in solidity code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: a bare send call matches. Calls on a parenthesised receiver, such as payable(x).send, are not matched. A user-defined send method (for example an ERC-777 token send) can match and is not a boolean call.
fpNotes: A user-defined send method that does not return a boolean is the common false positive.
